pnpm.buildComment: Packages allowed to run their install scripts. esbuild and sharp ship native binaries and do not work without them; msw writes its service worker. pnpm does not run these unless they are named here, and a recent pnpm exits non-zero rather than warning — so a clone on a machine that has never seen this project failed at install, after the image build, with an error that read as a pnpm problem rather than a repository one (#966). The suggested fix, `pnpm approve-builds`, is interactive and cannot be part of an unattended setup. Naming them here is that decision, made once, in the repository. Add to this list only for a package whose scripts are genuinely needed.
pnpm.comment: Overrides exist because these are transitive: next pins postcss 8.4.31 and sharp ^0.34.5 itself, so bumping our own dependency cannot reach them. Each override stays inside the package's own major version — the point is to clear the advisory, not to take a breaking upgrade. Drop an entry once the parent ships a version that no longer needs it. brace-expansion is pinned on both its major lines, separately: v1 exports the function directly and v5 exports { expand }, so forcing minimatch@3 onto 5.x would throw at runtime. The hono, node-server and body-parser overrides went with the scaffolding CLI that needed them — see app/vendor/shadcn-animations.css for why that left.
